# Springer LNCS template provenance

The project includes the unmodified `llncs.cls` and `splncs04.bst` files from
Springer's official LNCS package, version 2.26 (2025-02-25).

- Package page: <https://ctan.org/pkg/llncs>
- Download: <https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/llncs.zip>
- Retrieved: 2026-09-24
- Copyright: (c) 1996-2025 Springer
- License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 or later (CC BY 4.0+), as stated in
  the accompanying upstream README.
- License terms: <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>
- Changes to these two files: none.

`README.md` and `history.txt` in this directory are also unmodified upstream
files. The class and bibliography style reside at the project root so that
Overleaf finds them without configuration.
